# `/entitlements` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /entitlements/v1

`listEntitlementsV1` — Gets a list of entitlements.

This API returns a list of entitlements. Any authenticated token can call this API.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage, idn:entitlement:read
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `segmented-for-identity` (query) — If present and not empty, additionally filters Entitlements to those which are assigned to the Segment(s) which are visible to the Identity with the specified ID.
  - `for-segment-ids` (query) — If present and not empty, additionally filters Access Profiles to those which are assigned to the Segment(s) with the specified IDs.
  - `include-unsegmented` (query) — default True — Whether or not the response list should contain unsegmented Entitlements. If **for-segment-ids** and **segmented-for-identity** are both absent or empty, specifying **include-unsegmented=false**…
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `searchAfter` (query) — Used to begin the search window at the values specified. This parameter consists of the last values of the sorted fields in the current record set. searchAfter length must match the number of…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, created, modified, type, attribute, value, source.id, requestable — e.g. `name,id`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, in, sw; type: eq, in; attribute: eq, in; value: eq, in, sw; source.id: eq, in; requestable: eq; created: gt, lt, ge, le; modified: gt, lt, ge, le; owner.id: eq, in; tags: eq; privilegeLevel.direct: eq — e.g. `attribute eq "memberOf"`
- Returns 200: array of entitlementv2

### POST /entitlements/v1/bulk-update

`updateEntitlementsInBulkV1` — Bulk update an entitlement list

This API applies an update to every entitlement of the list. The number of entitlements to update is limited to 50 items maximum. The JsonPatch update follows the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard. examples of allowed operations : `**{ "op": "replace", "path": "/requestable","value": boolean }**` `**{ "op": "replace", "path": "/privilegeOverride/level","value": string }**` A token with ORG_ADMIN or API authority is required to call this API.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:update, idn:source-checked:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): entitlementbulkupdaterequest
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /entitlements/v1/{id}

`getEntitlementV1` — Get an entitlement

This API returns an entitlement by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage, idn:entitlement:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The entitlement ID
- Returns 200: entitlementv2

### PATCH /entitlements/v1/{id}

`patchEntitlementV1` — Patch an entitlement

This API updates an existing entitlement using [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) syntax. The following fields are patchable: **requestable**, **segments**, **privilegeOverride/level**, **owner**, **name**, **description**, **manuallyUpdatedFields**, and **accessModelMetadata** When you're patching owner, only owner type and owner id must be provided. Owner name is optional, and it won't be modified. If the owner name is provided, it should correspond to the real name. The only…

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the entitlement to patch
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: entitlementv2

### GET /entitlements/v1/{id}/entitlement-request-config

`getEntitlementRequestConfigV1` — Get entitlement request config

This API returns the entitlement request config for a specified entitlement. The `accessRequestConfig.formDefinitionId` field associates an optional custom form with entitlement access requests.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage, idn:entitlement:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Entitlement Id
- Returns 200: entitlementrequestconfig

### PUT /entitlements/v1/{id}/entitlement-request-config

`putEntitlementRequestConfigV1` — Replace entitlement request config

This API replaces the entitlement request config for a specified entitlement. Set `accessRequestConfig.formDefinitionId` to associate an optional custom form with entitlement access requests.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Entitlement ID
- Body (application/json): entitlementrequestconfig
- Returns 200: entitlementrequestconfig

### POST /entitlements/v1/reset/sources/{id}

`resetSourceEntitlementsV1` — Reset source entitlements

Remove all entitlements from a specific source. To reload the accounts along with the entitlements you removed, you must run an unoptimized aggregation. To do so, use [Account Aggregation](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/import-accounts-v-1) with `disableOptimization` = `true`.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of source for the entitlement reset
- Returns 202: entitlementsourceresetbasereferencedto

### POST /entitlements/v1/{id}/access-model-metadata/{attributeKey}/values/{attributeValue}

`createAccessModelMetadataForEntitlementV1` — Add metadata to an entitlement.

Add single Access Model Metadata to an entitlement.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:

  - `attributeKey` (path, required) — Technical name of the Attribute.

`deleteAccessModelMetadataFromEntitlementV1` — Remove metadata from an entitlement.

Remove single Access Model Metadata from an entitlement.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The entitlement id.

### POST /entitlements/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/ids

`updateEntitlementsMetadataByIdsV1` — Bulk-update metadata by ids

This API initiates a bulk update of Access Model Metadata for one or more entitlements by a list of entitlement IDs. The update is processed asynchronously. The response returns the ID of the task performing the update. The maximum entitlement count in a single request is 3000. Adding or replacing custom metadata requires a suite license. This API replaces the deprecated `updateAccessModelMetadataByIdsV1` operation.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): entitlementmetadatabulkupdatebyidrequest
- Returns 202: entitlementmetadatabulkupdateresponse

### POST /entitlements/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/filter

`updateEntitlementsMetadataByFilterV1` — Bulk-update metadata by filter

This API initiates a bulk update of Access Model Metadata for every entitlement matching the supplied filter expression. The update is processed asynchronously. The response returns the ID of the task performing the update. Adding or replacing custom metadata requires a suite license. This API replaces the deprecated `updateAccessModelMetadataByFilterV1` operation.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): entitlementmetadatabulkupdatebyfilterrequest
- Returns 202: entitlementmetadatabulkupdateresponse

### POST /entitlements/v1/access-model-metadata/bulk-update/query

`updateEntitlementsMetadataByQueryV1` — Bulk-update metadata by query

This API initiates a bulk update of Access Model Metadata for every entitlement matching the supplied search query. The update is processed asynchronously. The response returns the ID of the task performing the update. Adding or replacing custom metadata requires a suite license. This API replaces the deprecated `updateAccessModelMetadataByQueryV1` operation.

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): entitlementmetadatabulkupdatebyqueryrequest
- Returns 202: entitlementmetadatabulkupdateresponse

### POST /entitlements/v1/aggregate/sources/{id}

`importEntitlementsBySourceV1` — Aggregate entitlements — **DEPRECATED**

Starts an entitlement aggregation on the specified source. Though this endpoint has been deprecated, you can find its Beta equivalent [here](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/import-entitlements-v-1). If the target source is a direct connection, then the request body must be empty. You will also need to make sure the Content-Type header is not set. If you set the Content-Type header without specifying a body, then you will receive a 500 error. If the target source is a delimited file…

- Scopes: idn:entitlement:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Source Id
- Body (multipart/form-data): object
- Returns 202: loadentitlementtask
